description: For a retained ground argument tuple \(\bar t\), the specified positive-relation model satisfies \(R(\bar t)\) exactly when a positive input \(R(\bar u)\) has componentwise congruent arguments.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.model_relation_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L) {n : ℕ} (R : L.Relations n)
  (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L)
  (ht : ∀ (i : Fin n), ts i ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.rel R ts).Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Carrier Γ) ↔
    ∃ us,
      (true, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.rel R us) ∈ Γ ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin n), (us i, ts i) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.closure Γ
